description.en: What the village eats and drinks: bread, milk, tea and Cumbrian dishes, from tatie pot to sticky toffee pudding. Mrs Birkett serves them at the Packhorse Inn.
description.sl: Kaj v vasi jedo in pijejo: kruh, mleko, čaj in jedi iz Cumbrie, od tatie pota do sticky toffee pudinga. Gospa Birkett jih streže v gostilni Packhorse Inn.
description.it: Cosa si mangia e si beve in paese: pane, latte, tè e piatti della Cumbria, dal tatie pot allo sticky toffee pudding. La signora Birkett li serve al Packhorse Inn.
description.de: Was man im Dorf isst und trinkt: Brot, Milch, Tee und Gerichte aus Cumbria, vom Tatie Pot bis zum Sticky Toffee Pudding. Frau Birkett serviert sie im Packhorse Inn.

words.example_en: The bread is still warm.
words.example_it: Il pane è ancora caldo.
words.note: You can't count it: some bread, a loaf of bread, never a bread.
words.note_sl: Neštevno: some bread, a loaf of bread (hlebec kruha), nikoli a bread.
words.note_it: Non numerabile: some bread, a loaf of bread (una pagnotta), mai a bread.
words.note_de: Nicht zählbar: some bread, a loaf of bread (ein Laib Brot), nie a bread.

words.example_en: Two loaves of bread, please.
words.example_it: Due pagnotte, per favore.
words.note: One loaf, two loaves: f becomes v.
words.note_sl: En hlebec, dva: loaf, loaves (f postane v).
words.note_it: Plurale: loaves (la f diventa v).
words.note_de: Mehrzahl: loaves (aus f wird v).

words.example_en: I drink milk for breakfast.
words.example_it: A colazione bevo il latte.
words.note: In Britain milk goes in the tea, too.
words.note_sl: V Britaniji gre mleko tudi v čaj.
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna il latte si mette anche nel tè.
words.note_de: In Großbritannien kommt Milch auch in den Tee.

words.example_en: Can I have some water, please?
words.example_it: Posso avere un po' d'acqua, per favore?
words.example_de: Kann ich bitte etwas Wasser haben?

words.example_en: Tea with milk, please.
words.example_it: Un tè con il latte, per favore.
words.note: British tea is strong, with milk. In the north, tea is also the evening meal.
words.note_sl: Britanski čaj je močan, z mlekom. Na severu je tea tudi večerja.
words.note_it: Il tè britannico è forte, con il latte. Al nord tea è anche la cena.
words.note_de: Britischer Tee ist stark, mit Milch. Im Norden ist tea auch das Abendessen.

words.example_en: Poppy eats an apple every day.
words.example_it: Poppy mangia una mela ogni giorno.
words.example_de: Poppy isst jeden Tag einen Apfel.
words.note: An before a vowel sound: an apple, an egg; but a banana.
words.note_sl: Pred samoglasnikom an: an apple, an egg; sicer a: a banana.
words.note_it: Davanti a vocale an: an apple, an egg; altrimenti a: a banana.
words.note_de: Vor einem Vokal an: an apple, an egg; sonst a: a banana.

words.example_en: The hens lay eggs every morning.
words.example_it: Le galline fanno le uova ogni mattina.
words.example_de: Die Hühner legen jeden Morgen Eier.

words.example_en: A cheese sandwich, please.
words.example_it: Un panino al formaggio, per favore.

words.example_en: Bread and butter, please.
words.example_it: Pane e burro, per favore.
words.note: Rum butter is a Cumbrian treat: butter, brown sugar and rum.
words.note_sl: Rum butter je cumbrijski posladek: maslo, rjavi sladkor in rum.
words.note_it: Il rum butter è una golosità della Cumbria: burro, zucchero di canna e rum.
words.note_de: Rum butter ist eine Leckerei aus Cumbria: Butter, brauner Zucker und Rum.

words.example_en: Mr Tyson eats porridge every morning.
words.example_sl: Gospod Tyson vsako jutro je ovseno kašo.
words.example_it: Il signor Tyson mangia il porridge ogni mattina.
words.example_de: Herr Tyson isst jeden Morgen Haferbrei.
words.note: Hot oats with milk or water. Mr Tyson grinds the oats himself.
words.note_sl: Vroči ovseni kosmiči z mlekom ali vodo. Oves melje gospod Tyson sam.
words.note_it: Avena calda con latte o acqua. Il signor Tyson macina l'avena da solo.
words.note_de: Heißer Hafer mit Milch oder Wasser. Den Hafer mahlt Herr Tyson selbst.

words.example_en: Tatie pot has potatoes and lamb in it.
words.example_sl: V tatie potu sta krompir in jagnjetina.
words.example_it: Nel tatie pot ci sono patate e agnello.
words.example_de: Im Tatie Pot sind Kartoffeln und Lamm.
words.note: The plural takes -es: potatoes. In Cumbria a potato is a tatie.
words.note_sl: Množina z -es: potatoes. V Cumbrii krompirju rečejo tatie.
words.note_it: Plurale con -es: potatoes. In Cumbria la patata si chiama tatie.
words.note_de: Mehrzahl mit -es: potatoes. In Cumbria heißt die Kartoffel tatie.

words.it: il tatie pot (stufato di agnello e patate)
words.de: der Tatie Pot (Eintopf mit Lamm und Kartoffeln)
words.example_en: Mrs Birkett makes the best tatie pot.
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett skuha najboljši tatie pot.
words.example_it: La signora Birkett fa il tatie pot più buono.
words.example_de: Frau Birkett macht den besten Tatie Pot.
words.note: Cumbria's own dish: lamb, potatoes and onions, cooked slowly in the oven.
words.note_sl: Jed iz Cumbrie: jagnjetina, krompir in čebula, počasi pečeni v pečici.
words.note_it: Il piatto della Cumbria: agnello, patate e cipolle, cotti piano nel forno.
words.note_de: Das Gericht aus Cumbria: Lamm, Kartoffeln und Zwiebeln, langsam im Ofen gegart.

words.example_en: A Cumberland sausage is very long!
words.example_sl: Klobasa iz Cumberlanda je zelo dolga!
words.example_it: La salsiccia del Cumberland è lunghissima!
words.note: Cumberland sausage is one long coil, not little pieces.
words.note_sl: Klobasa iz Cumberlanda je ena dolga spirala, ne kratki kosi.
words.note_it: La salsiccia del Cumberland è un'unica lunga spirale, non tanti pezzetti.
words.note_de: Die Cumberland-Wurst ist eine lange Schnecke, keine kleinen Würstchen.

words.example_en: On Fridays we have fish and chips.
words.example_sl: Ob petkih jemo ribo in pomfri.
words.example_it: Il venerdì mangiamo pesce e patatine fritte.
words.example_de: Freitags essen wir Fisch mit Pommes.
words.note: One fish, two fish: the plural doesn't change. Chips are British fries; crisps come in a bag.
words.note_sl: Množina je enaka: one fish, two fish. Chips je pomfri; čips v vrečki je crisps.
words.note_it: Il plurale non cambia: two fish. Chips sono le patatine fritte; quelle in busta sono crisps.
words.note_de: Die Mehrzahl bleibt gleich: two fish. Chips sind Pommes; Kartoffelchips heißen crisps.

words.example_en: Would you like a piece of cake?
words.example_it: Vuoi una fetta di torta?
words.note: A piece of cake also means very easy!
words.note_sl: A piece of cake pomeni tudi »mala malica«: nekaj zelo lahkega!
words.note_it: A piece of cake vuol dire anche «un gioco da ragazzi»: facilissimo!
words.note_de: A piece of cake heißt auch »ein Kinderspiel«: ganz leicht!

words.example_en: Tea and a biscuit, love?
words.example_it: Tè e un biscotto, tesoro?
words.note: British biscuit, American cookie.
words.note_sl: Britansko biscuit, ameriško cookie.
words.note_it: In britannico biscuit, in americano cookie.
words.note_de: Britisch biscuit, amerikanisch cookie.

words.example_en: A scone with jam and cream, please.
words.example_sl: Scone z marmelado in smetano, prosim.
words.example_it: Uno scone con marmellata e panna, per favore.
words.example_de: Einen Scone mit Marmelade und Sahne, bitte.
words.note: Some say it to rhyme with gone, some with bone: the British argue about it!
words.note_sl: Nekateri ga izgovorijo kot gone, drugi kot bone: Britanci se o tem prepirajo!
words.note_it: Alcuni lo pronunciano come gone, altri come bone: i britannici ne discutono!
words.note_de: Manche sprechen es wie gone, andere wie bone: Die Briten streiten darüber!

words.example_en: Sam makes plum jam.
words.example_it: Sam fa la marmellata di prugne.
words.note: Jam is made of any fruit; marmalade is only made of oranges.
words.note_sl: Pazi: marmelada je jam; marmalade je samo pomarančna.
words.note_it: Attenzione: la marmellata è jam; marmalade è solo quella di arance.
words.note_de: Vorsicht: Marmelade ist jam; marmalade ist nur aus Orangen.

words.sl: sticky toffee puding (kolač s karamelno omako)
words.it: lo sticky toffee pudding (dolce al caramello)
words.de: der Sticky Toffee Pudding (Kuchen mit Karamellsoße)
words.example_en: On Sundays there's sticky toffee pudding!
words.example_sl: Ob nedeljah je sticky toffee puding!
words.example_it: La domenica c'è lo sticky toffee pudding!
words.example_de: Sonntags gibt es Sticky Toffee Pudding!
words.note: A warm sponge cake with dates and toffee sauce, from Cartmel. In Britain pudding also means any dessert.
words.note_sl: Topel biskvit z datlji in karamelno omako, iz Cartmela. V Britaniji pudding pomeni tudi vsako sladico.
words.note_it: Un dolce caldo con datteri e salsa al caramello, di Cartmel. In Gran Bretagna pudding vuol dire anche dessert.
words.note_de: Ein warmer Rührkuchen mit Datteln und Karamellsoße, aus Cartmel. In Großbritannien heißt pudding auch einfach Nachtisch.

words.example_en: I have breakfast at eight.
words.example_it: Faccio colazione alle otto.
words.note: You have breakfast, lunch and dinner.
words.note_sl: Zajtrkovati = have breakfast; tako tudi have lunch, have dinner.
words.note_it: Fare colazione = have breakfast (non make); così anche have lunch, have dinner.
words.note_de: Frühstücken = have breakfast; so auch have lunch, have dinner.

words.example_en: Lunch is ready!
words.example_it: Il pranzo è pronto!

words.example_en: Dinner is at seven.
words.example_it: La cena è alle sette.
words.note: In the north many people call lunch dinner, and the evening meal tea!
words.note_sl: Na severu Anglije mnogi kosilu rečejo dinner, večerji pa tea!
words.note_it: Nel nord dell'Inghilterra molti chiamano il pranzo dinner e la cena tea!
words.note_de: Im Norden Englands nennen viele das Mittagessen dinner und das Abendessen tea!

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett, I'm hungry! What's for lunch?
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett, lačen sem! Kaj je za kosilo?
words.example_it: Signora Birkett, ho fame! Cosa c'è per pranzo?
words.example_de: Frau Birkett, ich habe Hunger! Was gibt es zum Mittagessen?
words.note: With be: I'm hungry, I'm thirsty.
words.note_sl: Z be: I'm hungry, I'm thirsty (žejen sem).
words.note_it: Con be, non have: I'm hungry, I'm thirsty (mai I have hunger).
words.note_de: Mit be, nicht have: I'm hungry, I'm thirsty (nicht I have hunger).

words.example_en: Mrs Birkett, the tatie pot is delicious!
words.example_sl: Gospa Birkett, tatie pot je zelo okusen!
words.example_it: Signora Birkett, il tatie pot è buonissimo!
words.example_de: Frau Birkett, der Tatie Pot ist köstlich!
words.note: Only for food and drink; a nice day is lovely.
words.note_sl: Samo za hrano in pijačo; lep dan je lovely.
words.note_it: Solo per cibo e bevande; una bella giornata è lovely.
words.note_de: Nur für Essen und Trinken; ein schöner Tag ist lovely.
